tests.summary: The API service registration seeds direct browser API defaults.
tests.intent: Protect the DI setup that configures the ASP.NET Core wrapper for direct API mode.
tests.behavior: Calling AddOpenAIChatKitApi stores the configured API URL, domain key, and locale options.

tests.summary: The API service registration rejects direct API mode without a domain key.
tests.intent: Protect the DI setup from seeding an invalid direct ChatKit API configuration.
tests.behavior: Calling AddOpenAIChatKitApi without a domain key throws an argument-null exception.

tests.summary: The hosted service registration clears direct API defaults while preserving hosted configuration.
tests.intent: Protect the DI setup that switches consumers from direct API mode to hosted session mode.
tests.behavior: Calling AddOpenAIChatKitHosted resets the API URL and domain key while keeping the hosted session endpoint.

tests.summary: The ASP.NET Core endpoint adapter writes SSE responses for streaming ChatKit operations.
tests.intent: Protect the HTTP boundary for streamed ChatKit responses produced by the translated server surface.
tests.behavior: Posting a streaming ChatKit request returns an event-stream payload containing the created thread and assistant item events.

tests.summary: The ASP.NET Core endpoint adapter writes JSON responses for non-streaming ChatKit operations.
tests.intent: Protect the HTTP boundary for the translated ChatKit server surface.
tests.behavior: Posting a JSON ChatKit request returns a JSON payload with the expected thread data.

tests.summary: The assets tag helper emits each required asset only once per rendering context.
tests.intent: Protect the public Razor wrapper surface added to the ASP.NET Core package.
tests.behavior: CSS, package JS, and CDN JS are emitted on first render and suppressed on the second render in the same context.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper emits an error when the direct browser domain key is missing.
tests.intent: Protect the direct browser wrapper from serializing an invalid ChatKit API configuration.
tests.behavior: Direct browser API mode emits a render error instead of serializing a config payload when the domain key is missing.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper rejects hosted-only session endpoints in direct API mode.
tests.intent: Protect explicit direct API mode from serializing an ambiguous mixed-mode browser configuration.
tests.behavior: Providing session-endpoint to the API tag helper emits a render error instead of serializing a config payload.

tests.summary: The host config treats attachment constraints as an implicit request to enable attachments.
tests.intent: Protect the composer normalization path from dropping attachment limits when callers omit the explicit enabled flag.
tests.behavior: Providing attachment constraints without composer-attachments-enabled serializes composer attachments as enabled.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper infers the direct upload strategy when only an upload URL is provided.
tests.intent: Protect the upload-strategy normalization branch from dropping a valid direct-upload configuration.
tests.behavior: Providing upload-strategy-upload-url without an explicit upload-strategy-type serializes a direct upload strategy with that URL.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper serializes a client tool handler lookup path in direct API mode.
tests.intent: Protect the client tool callback parity surface for the direct browser API mode wrapper.
tests.behavior: Setting client-tool-handlers on the API tag helper serializes the lookup path into the browser host config so the runtime can wire onClientTool.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper serializes composer options and upload strategy metadata into the browser config payload.
tests.intent: Protect the packaged API-mode projection for attachments, composer pickers, dictation, and upload strategy.
tests.behavior: Configured API-mode composer defaults and explicit upload strategy settings appear in the serialized host config.

tests.summary: The API host tag helper forwards the configured domain key in direct browser API mode.
tests.intent: Protect the direct browser ChatKit configuration surface exposed by the ASP.NET Core wrapper.
tests.behavior: Configured direct browser API defaults populate both the API URL and domain key in the serialized host config.

tests.summary: The generic ChatKit tag helper now requires an explicit mode choice.
tests.intent: Prevent ambiguous Razor configuration that silently switches between local and API-backed modes.
tests.behavior: Using the generic host tag helper emits a render error instead of inferring a mode.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper omits the action endpoint when widget forwarding is disabled.
tests.intent: Protect the explicit hosted Razor wrapper surface added to the ASP.NET Core package.
tests.behavior: Disabling widget forwarding removes the action endpoint from the serialized config.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper rejects missing widget action endpoints when forwarding stays enabled.
tests.intent: Protect hosted mode from serializing a widget-forwarding configuration that cannot complete on the server.
tests.behavior: Hosted mode emits a render error when widget forwarding is enabled but no action endpoint is available.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper rejects half-configured header actions.
tests.intent: Protect the serialized browser config from carrying a header action the runtime cannot resolve safely.
tests.behavior: Providing only a header action icon without a callback lookup path emits a render error instead of serializing the action.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper rejects start prompts whose content is not a string or structured user-content sequence.
tests.intent: Protect the serialized start-screen config from carrying invalid prompt payloads that the browser runtime cannot interpret.
tests.behavior: Providing a starter prompt with invalid content emits a render error instead of serializing the prompt.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper omits disclaimer settings when no disclaimer text is configured.
tests.intent: Preserve the upstream disclaimer contract, which requires text when disclaimer settings are sent.
tests.behavior: High-contrast defaults alone do not serialize a disclaimer object into the browser config.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper supports client-only widget callbacks without requiring a forwarding endpoint.
tests.intent: Protect the upstream widgets.onAction parity surface in hosted mode.
tests.behavior: Registering a widget action callback while disabling forwarding preserves the client handler and omits the action endpoint.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper serializes a client tool handler lookup path set directly on the tag helper.
tests.intent: Protect the client tool callback parity surface exposed by the ASP.NET Core Razor wrapper.
tests.behavior: Setting the client-tool-handlers attribute serializes the lookup path into the browser host config so the runtime can wire onClientTool.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper serializes both a client handler and endpoint forwarding when both are configured.
tests.intent: Protect the coexistence contract where client handling and server forwarding are both active.
tests.behavior: When a widget action handler and forward-widget-actions are both configured, both are emitted so the runtime can run client handling first, then forward to the endpoint.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper serializes configured UI options and explicit attributes into the browser config payload.
tests.intent: Protect the public Razor wrapper surface added to the ASP.NET Core package.
tests.behavior: Configured options and explicit hosted tag helper attributes appear in the serialized host config.

tests.summary: The hosted ChatKit tag helper serializes explicit hosted session and action endpoints into the browser config payload.
tests.intent: Protect the explicit OpenAI-hosted wrapper surface.
tests.behavior: The hosted host tag helper emits the provided session and action endpoints and omits custom API settings.

tests.summary: The hosted host tag helper propagates a default client tool handler lookup path from service options.
tests.intent: Protect the server-side options path that wires onClientTool without requiring per-page tag helper attributes.
tests.behavior: Configuring ClientToolHandlers in AddOpenAIChatKitHosted populates the browser host config with the lookup path.

tests.summary: Agent context delegates thread and item identifier generation to the backing store using the expected item type and thread inputs.
tests.intent: Protect the bridge layer from generating incorrect ChatKit identifiers when materializing agent output.
tests.behavior: Generating a thread id uses the store thread path, and generating an item id uses the provided item type and thread metadata.

tests.summary: Buffered bridge events drain in FIFO order after they are recorded.
tests.intent: Protect the bridge layer from reordering events that should be emitted after an agent turn completes.
tests.behavior: Buffered events drain in the same order they were enqueued.

tests.summary: Widget buffering materializes a widget item event with the thread, copy text, and generated item identifier.
tests.intent: Protect widget bridge flows from dropping buffered widget events or generating them against the wrong thread context.
tests.behavior: Streaming a widget through the agent context buffers a completed widget item event that can be drained afterward.

tests.summary: Null items and unsupported agent output shapes are ignored instead of leaking partial or invalid transcript events.
tests.intent: Protect the bridge layer from surfacing unsupported upstream items into the public ChatKit event stream.
tests.behavior: Agent events without an item or with unsupported role/type combinations do not emit any ChatKit stream events.

tests.summary: Assistant message output is translated into a completed assistant thread item before any buffered post-turn events are drained.
tests.intent: Protect the public ChatKit transcript ordering when upstream agent output is converted into ChatKit stream events.
tests.behavior: Assistant message output emits a thread item done event, and buffered bridge events are emitted only after the agent stream finishes.

tests.summary: Tool-call agent output is translated into a pending client tool call item with object arguments preserved.
tests.intent: Protect client tool interoperability between upstream agent output and the ChatKit transcript model.
tests.behavior: Assistant tool-call output emits a pending client tool call item with the original tool name, call id, and object arguments.

tests.summary: Non-object tool-call argument payloads are normalized to an empty ChatKit argument bag instead of causing translation failures.
tests.intent: Protect the bridge layer from surfacing malformed upstream tool-call argument payloads as invalid ChatKit argument dictionaries.
tests.behavior: Assistant tool-call output with a non-object data payload emits a client tool call item whose arguments collection is empty.

tests.summary: Audio payloads expose a stable media type without MIME parameters.
tests.intent: Protect the transcription contract from treating codec or charset parameters as part of the media type identifier.
tests.behavior: The audio input media type accessor strips any MIME parameters and preserves only the base media type.

tests.summary: Unsupported event discriminators are rejected instead of silently producing an untyped placeholder.
tests.intent: Protect stream consumers from accepting unknown event types outside the approved contract inventory.
tests.behavior: Deserializing a thread stream event with an unsupported type discriminator throws a JSON exception.

tests.summary: Client-facing action configuration serializes with the expected snake-case field names and nested action payload.
tests.intent: Protect the public action contract consumed by ChatKit clients and widgets.
tests.behavior: Serializing an action configuration emits the expected field names, destructive flag, and nested JSON payload.

tests.summary: Representative request envelopes serialize with the exact upstream discriminators, default sort order, and snake-case metadata keys.
tests.intent: Protect the public ChatKit request contract across common list, custom action, and transcription paths.
tests.behavior: Serializing request envelopes emits the expected type discriminators, default descending order, and snake-case metadata fields.

tests.summary: Representative stream events serialize with the expected event/update discriminators and nested payload shapes.
tests.intent: Protect the public ChatKit event stream contract across thread lifecycle, workflow, widget, and client-effect paths.
tests.behavior: Serializing stream events emits the expected outer event discriminators and nested polymorphic payload types.

tests.summary: Widget transcript items preserve newer upstream root and component shapes without requiring typed .NET wrappers for each addition.
tests.intent: Protect the generic widget wire contract when upstream ChatKit adds new widget roots or component types that the current .NET model can already represent.
tests.behavior: Serializing and deserializing a widget item with a Basic root, table hierarchy, and Card border properties preserves the current upstream type names and nested payload members.

tests.summary: Client tool call transcript items translate into agent tool-call items with preserved identifiers, arguments, and status.
tests.intent: Protect interoperability between persisted ChatKit tool calls and the shared agents runtime.
tests.behavior: Mapping a client tool call item to agent input preserves its tool type, name, call id, arguments, and pending status.

tests.summary: Widget rendering rejects constant mismatches before template hydration occurs.
tests.intent: Protect schema-based widget validation from allowing invalid constant values into rendered output.
tests.behavior: Rendering a widget with a property that does not match the required constant value throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Widget rendering rejects enum violations before template hydration occurs.
tests.intent: Protect schema-based widget validation from allowing invalid enum selections into the rendered output.
tests.behavior: Rendering a widget with an enum value outside the schema inventory throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Widget rendering supplies schema-shaped empty values for optional properties that are omitted from state.
tests.intent: Protect the widget renderer from failing when optional arrays and objects are missing from otherwise valid state.
tests.behavior: Rendering a widget with omitted optional schema members supplies empty defaults that the template can safely read.

tests.summary: Request deserialization rejects null envelopes instead of producing an untyped placeholder.
tests.intent: Protect request routing from silently accepting invalid root request payloads.
tests.behavior: Deserializing a null ChatKit request payload throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Thread item list responses exclude hidden context items even when they remain persisted in storage.
tests.intent: Protect the public ChatKit item-list contract from leaking hidden context back to clients.
tests.behavior: Listing thread items returns visible user-facing items and omits hidden context item variants from the serialized response payload.

tests.summary: Thread detail responses exclude hidden context items even when they remain persisted in storage.
tests.intent: Protect the public ChatKit thread contract from leaking hidden context back to clients.
tests.behavior: Loading a thread by id returns visible user-facing items and omits hidden context item variants from the serialized response payload.

tests.summary: Unknown request discriminators are rejected instead of being treated as a valid ChatKit request kind.
tests.intent: Protect request routing from silently accepting request types outside the approved protocol inventory.
tests.behavior: Processing a request payload with an unsupported type discriminator throws a JSON exception.

tests.summary: Widget definitions reject unsupported export versions before rendering begins.
tests.intent: Protect file-backed widget loading from silently accepting incompatible export formats.
tests.behavior: Parsing a widget definition with an unsupported version throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Streaming widget diffs fall back to a root replacement when text no longer follows append-only semantics.
tests.intent: Protect incremental widget updates from emitting an invalid delta when the new text is incompatible with the prior streamed value.
tests.behavior: Diffing a streaming text node whose updated value no longer begins with the prior value emits a widget root replacement instead of a text delta.

tests.summary: Attachment creation persists the created descriptor when an attachment store is configured.
tests.intent: Protect the external attachment creation lane owned by the core runtime and attachment store boundary.
tests.behavior: Processing an attachments.create request calls the configured attachment store, persists the returned attachment, and returns the created payload as JSON.

tests.summary: Attachment operations reject requests when no external attachment store has been configured.
tests.intent: Protect attachment endpoints from appearing enabled when the repo owner has not supplied an attachment implementation.
tests.behavior: Processing an attachments.create request without an attachment store throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Attachment deletion removes persisted descriptors and forwards the delete to the attachment store.
tests.intent: Protect the two-phase attachment delete workflow from leaving stale records behind.
tests.behavior: Processing an attachments.delete request calls the configured attachment store delete hook and removes the attachment from the backing ChatKit store.

tests.summary: Attachment deletion rejects requests when no external attachment store has been configured.
tests.intent: Protect attachment delete endpoints from appearing enabled when the repo owner has not supplied an attachment implementation.
tests.behavior: Processing an attachments.delete request without an attachment store throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Stream cancellation persists non-empty pending assistant content and an SDK hidden-context marker.
tests.intent: Protect cancellation cleanup so partially emitted assistant content and the interruption marker survive for later turns.
tests.behavior: Canceling a streaming threads.create request after a non-empty assistant item is added persists that partial item and appends an SDK hidden-context item.

tests.summary: Stream cancellation skips empty pending assistant content instead of persisting blank items.
tests.intent: Protect cancellation cleanup from polluting persisted history with empty assistant placeholders.
tests.behavior: Canceling a streaming request after an empty assistant item is added does not persist that assistant item, but still appends the SDK hidden-context marker.

tests.summary: Client tool output completes the pending tool-call item before the assistant response continues.
tests.intent: Protect the tool continuation lane used when the client returns a tool result into an existing thread.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.add_client_tool_output request marks the pending tool call completed, persists the tool result, and then streams the next assistant response.

tests.summary: Client tool output rejects threads that do not end with a pending tool-call item.
tests.intent: Protect the continuation pipeline from applying client tool results to the wrong kind of thread item.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.add_client_tool_output request without a pending client tool call throws an invalid operation exception during stream evaluation.

tests.summary: Asynchronous custom actions load the widget sender and stream the action result.
tests.intent: Protect the custom widget-action lane from losing the sender context before the server action hook runs.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.custom_action request with a widget item sender passes that widget to the action hook and streams the resulting assistant item.

tests.summary: Asynchronous custom actions reject sender items that are not widgets.
tests.intent: Protect the widget-action pipeline from passing a non-widget thread item into the action hook.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.custom_action request with a non-widget sender item throws an invalid operation exception during stream evaluation.

tests.summary: Retry-after-item removes later items and replays the assistant turn from the retained user message.
tests.intent: Protect the destructive retry lane from leaving superseded items behind after a replay.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.retry_after_item request deletes later items after the target user message and streams a replacement assistant response based on that retained message.

tests.summary: Retry-after-item rejects non-user-message targets instead of replaying from an invalid point in the thread.
tests.intent: Protect destructive retry from treating assistant or system items as valid replay anchors.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.retry_after_item request for an assistant item throws an invalid operation exception during stream evaluation.

tests.summary: Synchronous custom actions load the widget sender and return a JSON response from the sync action hook.
tests.intent: Protect the synchronous custom action lane from losing sender context or drifting away from the non-streaming response contract.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.sync_custom_action request with a widget item sender passes that widget to the sync action hook and returns the serialized updated item.

tests.summary: Synchronous custom actions reject sender items that are not widgets.
tests.intent: Protect the synchronous widget-action pipeline from passing a non-widget thread item into the sync action hook.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.sync_custom_action request with a non-widget sender item throws an invalid operation exception.

tests.summary: Threads create requests stream the created thread and assistant response events through the ChatKit pipeline.
tests.intent: Protect the core thread routing path used by hosted ChatKit servers.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.create payload produces stream events for thread creation and the completed assistant item.

tests.summary: Threads create requests serialize with the upstream ChatKit discriminator and payload field names.
tests.intent: Protect exact wire compatibility for the core request envelope.
tests.behavior: Serializing a threads.create request emits the expected type discriminator and content payload shape.

tests.summary: ChatKit conversation items map into the agent input shape expected by the agents dependency.
tests.intent: Protect interop between ChatKit message history and the shared agents runtime.
tests.behavior: Simple user and assistant items are translated into the corresponding agent conversation item types and text values.

tests.summary: Widget exports reject state that does not satisfy the exported JSON schema.
tests.intent: Protect schema-based input validation before widget rendering occurs.
tests.behavior: Rendering a widget with invalid input state fails before the Jinja template is hydrated into a widget root.

tests.summary: Widget exports load from disk or stream, preserve their metadata, and hydrate widget roots from valid input state.
tests.intent: Protect the file-backed widget template abstraction used by downstream ChatKit integrations.
tests.behavior: Loading a widget export from disk or stream preserves the template, schema, preview, and encoded payload, and building with valid state hydrates the preview widget.

tests.summary: Widget exports also load from streams and hydrate the widget preview using the same Jinja-backed pipeline.
tests.intent: Protect the stream-based widget definition API used by downstream integrations.
tests.behavior: Loading a widget export from a stream preserves the template, schema, preview, and encoded payload, and building with valid state hydrates the preview widget.

tests.summary: Streaming text widgets emit deltas instead of forcing a root replacement when text is appended.
tests.intent: Protect incremental widget updates for ChatKit streaming UI flows.
tests.behavior: Diffing compatible before and after widgets returns only the appended text delta and completion state.

tests.summary: Unexpected stream failures collapse to the canonical runtime stream error code with retry enabled.
tests.intent: Protect public stream error behavior when an unhandled runtime failure escapes the response stream.
tests.behavior: When a response stream throws an unexpected exception, the emitted error event uses the canonical stream error code and allows retry.

tests.summary: Custom stream failures surface the default custom error code and preserve retry/message semantics.
tests.intent: Protect public stream error behavior for application-defined failures that intentionally use the default ChatKit custom code.
tests.behavior: When a response stream throws a custom stream exception, the emitted error event uses the custom code and preserves the configured retry and message values.

tests.summary: Explicit stream failures surface their configured protocol code and preserve retry/message semantics.
tests.intent: Protect public stream error behavior for failures that intentionally choose a non-default protocol code.
tests.behavior: When a response stream throws a stream exception, the emitted error event uses the configured code and preserves the configured retry and message values.

tests.summary: The stream exception types preserve the configured public code, retry, and message values.
tests.intent: Protect the exception contracts that the runtime translates into public ChatKit error events.
tests.behavior: Constructed stream exception types expose the expected code, retry, and message property values.

tests.summary: Audio transcription requests decode the audio payload, normalize the MIME type, and pass both values into the explicit transcription hook.
tests.intent: Protect the transcription route from losing the uploaded bytes or bypassing the application-owned transcription service.
tests.behavior: Processing an input.transcribe request decodes the base64 audio input, forwards it to TranscribeAsync, and serializes the returned text.

tests.summary: Malformed transcription payloads fail fast before the transcription hook is invoked.
tests.intent: Protect the transcription route from accepting invalid base64 audio data as if it were valid input.
tests.behavior: Processing an input.transcribe request with an invalid base64 payload throws a format exception and does not call TranscribeAsync.

tests.summary: Audio transcription requests fail fast when a server does not override the transcription extension point.
tests.intent: Protect the transcription route from implying a default transcription implementation where none exists.
tests.behavior: Processing an input.transcribe request against a server that has not overridden TranscribeAsync throws the base not-implemented exception.

tests.summary: Feedback requests hand their thread and item identifiers to the explicit extension hook instead of hard-coding repository-specific behavior.
tests.intent: Protect the feedback route from bypassing the server extension point that owns application-specific feedback handling.
tests.behavior: Processing an items.feedback request forwards the thread id, item ids, and feedback kind to AddFeedbackAsync and returns an empty object.

tests.summary: Attached files and images are normalized to the destination thread before the owning user message is persisted.
tests.intent: Protect the attachment lifecycle from losing thread ownership or saving the user turn before its attachments are materialized.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.add_user_message request with attachments rewrites the attachment thread ids, persists the attachments first, and then stores the user message.

tests.summary: Adding a user message to an existing thread persists the user turn and streams the assistant response from the translated hook.
tests.intent: Protect the add-user-message lane from losing the user payload or skipping store-backed persistence before the assistant turn begins.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.add_user_message request stores the user message, passes it into RespondAsync, and streams the assistant reply.

tests.summary: Thread deletion removes the thread and its items instead of leaving stale conversation state behind.
tests.intent: Protect the delete route from orphaning items after the owning thread has been removed.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.delete request removes the thread from the store and returns an empty JSON object.

tests.summary: Thread listings preserve explicit cursors and limits when callers request a smaller page.
tests.intent: Protect the translated pagination contract from regressions in limit and cursor propagation.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.list request with an explicit limit and cursor returns the requested page and exposes the next-page cursor.

tests.summary: Thread listings honor the translated default page size and descending sort order when no cursor is provided.
tests.intent: Protect the non-streaming thread list route from silently drifting away from the translated pagination contract.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.list request without an explicit limit passes the default page size to the store and returns the newest threads first.

tests.summary: Thread metadata updates are persisted through the store boundary and returned as the updated public thread shape.
tests.intent: Protect the update route from mutating thread titles without writing through the storage boundary.
tests.behavior: Processing a threads.update request saves the updated title and returns the updated thread payload.

tests.summary: The release versioning script can advance from a tagged commit when the working tree is dirty.
tests.intent: Protect release versioning for local release preparation on top of an already-tagged HEAD commit.
tests.behavior: When HEAD already has a release tag and tracked changes exist, the script continues instead of failing on the existing HEAD tag guard.

tests.summary: The release versioning script can preview the computed version without changing the repository.
tests.intent: Support a safe check for what the next release would be before committing to any release action.
tests.behavior: When calculate-only mode is used, the script reports the computed bump and exits before validation or repo mutation.

tests.summary: The release versioning script can honor a manual minor bump override when the public API diff looks breaking.
tests.intent: Protect the explicit bump override path for semver exceptions that are intentionally non-breaking.
tests.behavior: When the shipped API diff would normally require a major bump, the script respects -Bump Minor and the validator accepts it.

tests.summary: The upstream sync state helper bootstraps ChatKit-specific tracked and local state defaults.
tests.intent: Protect the repeatable initialization path for the upstream synchronization workflow.
tests.behavior: Initializing sync state emits ChatKit upstream metadata and creates both tracked and local state files when missing.

tests.summary: The upstream sync prompt builder carries the ChatKit translation constraints and trims oversized diff content.
tests.intent: Protect the Codex prompt contract used for automated upstream translation runs.
tests.behavior: Building a prompt includes the ChatKit guidance and notes content while truncating large diff excerpts.

tests.summary: The upstream sync metadata helpers produce ChatKit-specific branch, commit, and pull request text.
tests.intent: Protect predictable naming for automated sync branches and PRs.
tests.behavior: Generating sync metadata returns the expected ChatKit branch name, commit text, and commit summary body.
